description: This PHP source file defines the EmailAddressRelationship class, which represents a many-to-many relationship (table-based) specifically for email addresses within the SuiteCRM project. It extends the M2MRelationship class and customizes the add/remove methods to handle email address relationships uniquely.

classes.name: EmailAddressRelationship
classes.description: Represents a specialized many-to-many relationship for email addresses within SuiteCRM, extending the M2MRelationship base class and overriding add and remove methods to suit email address linking logic.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a relationship between the left and right beans, with specific logic for email address relationships, including loading relationships if necessary and invoking hooks.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the relationship between the left and right beans, including relationship loading, validation, and callback invocations.

methods.name: getRoleWhere
methods.description: Overrides the base method to add additional filtering based on 'primary_address' role attributes in the relationship.
